acf.s119_p: B Residency by investment
acf.s121_p: You invest for a residence permit in Curacao — part of the Kingdom of the Netherlands — with a route to Dutch, and therefore EU, citizenship after 5 years.
acf.s123_p: FROM US$280,000 · GATEWAY TO THE NETHERLANDS (EU)
acf.s134_p: part of the Kingdom of the Netherlands
acf.s139_p: Dutch citizenship after 5 years → full EU citizenship rights.

acf.s148_p: After 5 years → a route to Dutch citizenship; with a Dutch passport, you can live anywhere in the 27 EU countries
